lines.text: WoW: Forever's open Stress Test is set for Oct 21 at 2:00 p.m. PDT (no subscription needed), Hallow's End is now official with neighborhood themes and new decor, and the Rexxar Champion of the Wilds Pack ($30) is in the shop through Nov 8

Pokemon GO's Oct 31 Super Mega Raid Day is confirmed as Mega Chandelure's debut ($4.99 ticket), and Into the Wild Nov 9-13 (Dynamax Regidrago and Meltan, Crowned Zacian and Zamazenta raids, $14.99 GO Pass) is official

Aniimo's Part II preview is official: the Whisperwake Isles region, Night Parade and Magical Night Halloween events from Oct 29, Hoptail Nov 6-19 and Prismana Snapshots Nov 12-29; the window now reaches November Community Day (Nov 21) and Pilgrim's Bounty (Nov 22-29)
Ended and dropped: Sandile Hatch Day and Fall Marathon: Buddy Trek; the TCG 30th Celebration store pickup ends tonight

needs_you.action: Open the game inside a participating Best Buy, GameStop or Target by 10pm local tonight to pick up the TCG 30th Celebration Timed Research; redeem a store-bought GO gift card by Oct 31 for the Gengar Knit Cap
City Safari: Boston ticket holders who do not want the rescheduled global gameplay Oct 24-25 must request a refund through in-app support by Oct 20 at 11:59pm EST
Claim any unlocked GO Pass: Fall Marathon rewards before they expire Oct 21 at 8pm local
Last day of the Forever beta; the open Stress Test starts Oct 21 at 2:00 p.m. PDT for anyone with a WoW account, no subscription needed, and every character is wiped afterward
Buy the $4.99 Max Battle Day ticket before sales close Oct 24 at 5pm local, then watch 30 minutes of the Pokemon Twitch stream from 7:30pm PDT for the Night Out jersey code
Earn the limited-time "Fabled Let Me Solo Him: Kindo'jan" achievement before weekly maintenance on Oct 27, when it is removed
Early Name Reservation opens Oct 27 (through Nov 3) for upgrade buyers; two-part names are first come, first served
Spend Windborn Stamps and finish the Companion Handbook before Part I ends Oct 28 at 11:59pm UTC (7:59pm on the Americas server), when leftover stamps convert to Credits
Claim the last Journey Chronicles login gifts, including the day-7 Sparkling Egg, before the event closes Oct 29 at 3:59am Americas server time
Finish the October Traveler's Log for the Thornshadow Assassin's Attire and spend or freeze Trader's Tender before the Trading Post rotates to November on Nov 1
Buy the $4.99 Chandelure Super Mega Raid Day ticket before sales close Oct 31 at 5pm local if you want the extra Raid Passes and bonus XP and Stardust
Trade pumpkin candy for Pumpkaboo's event furniture at the Pokemon Center before Pumpkaboo's Sweet Surprises ends Nov 1 at 4:59am local
Watch 4 hours of any World of Warcraft Twitch stream with a linked Battle.net account before Nov 3 at 10am PST to claim the Cuddly Gold-Colored Grrgle housing decor
Rank up GO Pass: October before rank earning stops Nov 3 at 10am local, using the uncapped GO Points Oct 31 - Nov 1; rewards expire Nov 5, and the Deluxe Lucky Trinket must be used by Nov 8
Rank up GO Pass: Halloween 2026 before it ends Nov 5 at 8pm local; unlocked rewards expire Nov 7 at 8pm
Decide on the Champion of the Wilds Pack (Rexxar's Fabled Attire, Hunter companion toy, Zhevraskin Rug) before it leaves the shop Nov 9 at 10:00 a.m. PST
Friends must redeem an Invite-A-Friend Launch Code on Battle.net by Nov 11; after that the code errors and launch-week access ends
Buy the $11.99 GO Wild Area: Global ticket on the Web Store before Nov 14 if you want the Gigantamax Duraludon Special Research, Shiny boost and 6 Special Trades a day across both event days
Claim GO Pass: Into the Wild rewards by Nov 17 at 11:59pm local (rank earning stops Nov 15 at 6pm); the Deluxe Silver Bottle Cap expires Nov 22
Finish and claim the TCG 30th Celebration Timed Research by Nov 20 at 10pm local or its rewards are lost

games.typical_lead_time: Blizzard posts holiday and patch dates about 1-2 weeks ahead; Wowhead's calendar runs further out

timeline.title: Midnight 12.1.5: The Promise of Tomorrow
timeline.detail: After the eight-hour Oct 20 maintenance (7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. PT) the crest cap lifts and Orin's "Ascending with Venomstones" quest unlocks Ascendant Venomstones from Heroic and Mythic raid bosses, +10 keys and Tier 11 Bountiful Delves; the Unbinding of Kith'ix raid, Labyrinth of Kindo'jan and Aqir Invasions stay live.

timeline.title: Midnight Season 2 and the Venomous Abyss
timeline.detail: Season 2 continues with the Venomous Abyss raid and the 12.1.5 mid-season refresh; Blizzard has not announced a Season 2 end date.

timeline.title: Hallow's End
timeline.detail: New this year: Midnight Candy Buckets across Quel'Thalas, neighborhood Hallow's End themes with daily quests and a Wickerman pinata, seven achievements (Scarecrow Pepe decor), and the Headless Horseman drops one guaranteed Ghoulish Armor piece a day plus a chance at his mount.

timeline.title: Twitch Drop: Cuddly Gold-Colored Grrgle decor
timeline.detail: Watch 4 hours of any WoW stream on Twitch between Oct 13 at 10:00 a.m. PDT and Nov 3 at 10:00 a.m. PST with linked accounts, then buy extra copies from Dennia Silvertongue in Silvermoon.

timeline.title: Trading Post: October's Hallow's End stock
timeline.detail: Fill the Traveler's Log for Ensemble: Thornshadow Assassin's Attire and spend or freeze Tender before the stock changes over on Nov 1; Blizzard has not posted November's lineup (datamined theme: Food, Glorious Food).

timeline.title: Warlords of Draenor Timewalking
timeline.detail: Queue Draenor Timewalking for the weekly cache and the Garrison-era vendor transmog.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire (November)
timeline.detail: Ride the carousel for the XP buff and turn in profession quests during the Faire's November week.

timeline.title: Day of the Dead
timeline.detail: Visit a graveyard outside a capital city to dance with Catrina for the Macabre Marionette pet and holiday cooking.

timeline.title: Midnight Dungeon Event
timeline.detail: The final boss of every Midnight dungeon drops an extra item; complete four Mythic runs for the weekly bonus-event cache.

timeline.title: Moonkin Festival (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Spend a day as a moonkin in Moonglade for the micro-holiday's toys and achievements.

timeline.title: WoW's 22nd Anniversary
timeline.detail: The anniversary celebration runs Nov 17 to Dec 8 per the in-game calendar; Blizzard has not posted this year's rewards yet.

timeline.title: Legion Timewalking
timeline.detail: Legion Timewalking returns with the Mage Tower challenge and its dungeon week starting Nov 17.

timeline.title: Pilgrim's Bounty
timeline.detail: Cook the five Bountiful Feast dishes for easy Cooking levels and the Plump Turkey pet during Thanksgiving week.

timeline.title: Champion of the Wilds Pack (Rexxar)
timeline.detail: Ensemble: Rexxar's Fabled Attire, the Hunter-only Companion Transformation toy and the Zhevraskin Rug leave the shop Nov 9 at 10:00 a.m. PST; Blizzard's post lists no price, Wowhead reports $30.

timeline.title: 12-Month Subscription bonus items
timeline.detail: A 12-month sub or 365 days of Game Time adds the Ashen Dreadglider and Giant Grrloc mounts, Forever-only tabard, backpack and Azurky pet, plus the Lunar New Year bonuses; bonuses arrive by Oct 31 and must be redeemed by Apr 30, 2027.

timeline.title: Hexed Witchwick Collection
timeline.detail: Four broom-mount and transmog packs (Blushing, Autumnal, Wintry, Moonlit) sell for $25 each or $50 for all four, with the price adjusting for pieces you already own.

timeline.title: Whoofle Bramblewing owl mount
timeline.detail: The new $25 owl mount is shared across all modern WoW characters and works as a ground mount until flying unlocks.

weekly_rhythm: Week of Oct 20 (now): eight-hour NA maintenance Oct 20, 7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. PT; Delves Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Deepwind Dunk; crest cap lifted and Ascendant Venomstones unlocked via Orin's "Ascending with Venomstones"; the limited-time "Fabled Let Me Solo Him: Kindo'jan" achievement lasts until Oct 27 maintenance

Week of Oct 27: Warlords of Draenor Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Shado-Pan Showdown; Trading Post rotates to November on Nov 1 (lineup unannounced); Darkmoon Faire Nov 1-7; Day of the Dead Nov 1-3; Hallow's End ends Nov 2
Week of Nov 3: Midnight Dungeon Event; PvP Brawl: Warsong Scramble; Grrgle Twitch drop ends Nov 3 at 10:00 a.m. PST; WoW: Forever launches Nov 4; Rexxar pack leaves the shop Nov 9 at 10:00 a.m. PST
Week of Nov 10: Arena Skirmish Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Cooking Impossible; Moonkin Festival Nov 12-13
Week of Nov 17: WoW's 22nd Anniversary begins (through Dec 8); Legion Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Temple of Hotmogu; Pilgrim's Bounty from Nov 22
Nov 24 (window end): World Quest Bonus Event and PvP Brawl: Southshore vs. Tarren Mill begin at reset; Pilgrim's Bounty runs through Nov 29
12.1.7 Echoes of the Worldcore (Return to Dornogal campaign, Talebound mode, Lorewalking, Turbulent Timeways VI) is on the PTR with no release date; Wowhead expects December
just_past_window: Dec 1-8: Pet Battle Bonus Event (Wowhead's calendar also lists a Battleground Bonus Event that week) and PvP Brawl: Classic Ashran; Trading Post rotates Dec 1
Dec 7-8: Wanderer's Festival micro-holiday; Dec 8: the 22nd Anniversary ends and Battle for Azeroth Timewalking plus PvP Brawl: Packed House begin
12.1.7 release: undated, estimated December per Wowhead and Blizzard Watch

games.typical_lead_time: Blizzard posts Forever dates on the WoW news site, usually 1-2 weeks ahead

timeline.title: WoW: Forever beta (last day Oct 21)
timeline.detail: Beta access for Epic Pack and Collection buyers and opt-in invitees ends Oct 21 PDT; the beta goes offline for the Stress Test that afternoon and reopens briefly afterward.

timeline.title: Open Stress Test (no subscription needed)
timeline.detail: Install "World of Warcraft: Forever Stress Test" from the Battle.net app's In Development list and play for a few hours on the live launch hardware; every character, name and guild is wiped afterward.

timeline.title: Invite-A-Friend Launch Codes
timeline.detail: Codes email to Heroic (one) and Epic or Collection (three) buyers from Oct 20; a friend redeems one on Battle.net by Nov 11 to play launch week Nov 4-11 without a subscription.

timeline.title: Escape Together: Scarlet Monastery showdown stream
timeline.detail: Watch Horde and Alliance teams race through head-to-head challenges and a Scarlet Monastery escape room on the Warcraft Twitch and YouTube channels; Blizzard still has not announced the stream time.

timeline.title: Early Name Reservation
timeline.detail: Any upgrade buyer can create and customize up to three characters and lock two-part names, first come first served, before launch; Blizzard has not posted a clock time.

timeline.title: WoW: Forever launches
timeline.detail: Forever opens globally at 3:00 p.m. PST with 4 new zones, 9 new dungeons, the Skyborne race and the 15v15 Darkspear Islands battleground, included with any WoW subscription or Game Time; Epic Pack and Collection buyers get 30 days of Game Time added that day.

timeline.title: Pre-purchase upgrades: Heroic $29.99, Epic $59.99, Collection $79.99
timeline.detail: The Skyborne Heroic Pack unlocks the Skyborne race and name reservation, the Epic Pack adds 30 days of Game Time, and the Warcraft Forever Collection adds Warcraft III: Reforged with Forsaken Kingdom and is sold only through Jan 11, 2027.

timeline.title: Collector's Edition
timeline.detail: The physical Collector's Edition (statue, mousepad, pins, journal and the Collection digital code) is one per household and read as sold out on the Gear Store on Oct 20; any restock order ships February 2027.

weekly_rhythm: Oct 21 Stress Test runs on the regional launch hardware for anyone with a WoW account; all characters, names and guilds are wiped afterward so Name Reservation starts clean on Oct 27
Rulesets at launch are Normal, PvP and Roleplaying, with Hardcore "sometime after launch" (Blizzard) or winter 2026 (Wowhead); a PvP-ruleset account can only make characters for one faction

12-month subscription or 365-day Game Time bonuses (Oct 15 post) include the Forever-only Tabard of Eternal Exploration, Eternal Explorer's Backpack and Azurky pet; they arrive by Oct 31 and must be redeemed by Apr 30, 2027
Per Wowhead's roadmap: the first three raids (Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit, Onyxia's Lair) open Dec 9; Blizzard has not dated them in a news post
Invite-A-Friend guests lose access after Nov 11 and need a subscription or Game Time from then on; Blizzard has not said whether Hallow's End or Pilgrim's Bounty run in Forever

games.typical_lead_time: Niantic posts event details 1-3 weeks ahead; the month's schedule drops near the end of the prior month

timeline.title: Season 24: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: Seasonal spawns, Paldean debuts, Mega Staraptor and Chandelure, and GO Battle League Mega Editions run through Dec 1 at 10am local.

timeline.title: GO Pass: October
timeline.detail: Free track pays out a Kyogre encounter; Deluxe ($7.99, or $9.99 with 10 ranks) adds a Lucky Trinket and Super Incubator; GO Points are uncapped Oct 31 - Nov 1, rewards expire Nov 5 at 10am local and the Lucky Trinket on Nov 8.

timeline.title: Pokemon TCG 30th Celebration (last day)
timeline.detail: Open the game inside a Best Buy, GameStop or Target before 10pm local tonight to grab the Timed Research (finish and claim by Nov 20 at 10pm); redeem a store-bought GO gift card by Oct 31 for the Gengar Knit Cap.

timeline.title: adidas | Pokemon Timed Research
timeline.detail: Pick up the free Timed Research at a participating adidas store by Jan 15 for the jacket and cap (claim by Feb 13, 2027), and redeem code ADIDASxPOKEMON on the Web Store for the shoes.

timeline.title: Minior Showers: Orionids
timeline.detail: Minior debuts in the wild from Oct 19 at 5pm through Oct 24 at 11:59pm local, with shooting-star skies and boosted spawns 5-9pm nightly and extra Stardust per catch.

timeline.title: Dynamax Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf Max Battle Day
timeline.detail: Dynamax Azelf debuts in the Americas with 8x Max Particles from Power Spots; the $4.99 ticket (Max Mushroom, 6,400 MP) is only sold until 5pm local, and the remote raid cap doubles Oct 23-24.

timeline.title: City Safari: Boston (rescheduled, ticket holders only)
timeline.detail: The washed-out Boston event now runs as global gameplay for current ticket holders, with Timed Research for Flabebe, Hawlucha, Mudbray and Komala; refunds must be requested by Oct 20 at 11:59pm EST.

timeline.title: Pokemon Night Out Twitch drop
timeline.detail: Watch 30 minutes of the Pokemon Twitch stream with a linked Trainer Central account for a Timed Research code that unlocks the Night Out baseball jersey.

timeline.title: Halloween 2026 Part I
timeline.detail: Costumed Pikachu, Zubat and Sinistea debut with trick-or-treat surprises; the Halloween GO Pass runs through Nov 5 (Deluxe $7.99, or $9.99 with 10 ranks) and its rewards expire Nov 7 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Chandelure Super Mega Raid Day
timeline.detail: Mega Chandelure debuts with Super Max level and Ominous Wind+; the $4.99 ticket (up to 14 Raid Passes, extra XP and Stardust) sells until 5pm local, and the remote raid cap is 20 from Oct 30 at 5pm PDT.

timeline.title: Halloween 2026 Part II
timeline.detail: Shiny Greavard debuts in the wild and research, Mega Sableye can reach Super Max level with the Night Shade+ Charged Attack, and the shared Halloween GO Pass closes Nov 5 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Into the Wild
timeline.detail: Dynamax Regidrago and Meltan debut, Crowned Zacian and Zamazenta hit raids (Raid Hours Mon Nov 9 and Tue Nov 10), and the GO Pass: Into the Wild (Deluxe $14.99, or $19.99 with 10 ranks) runs to Nov 15 at 6pm with rewards claimable through Nov 17.

timeline.title: Pokemon GO Wild Area 2026: Global
timeline.detail: Gigantamax Duraludon, Dynamax Dialga (Nov 14) and Dynamax Palkia (Nov 15) debut with Steel and Dragon habitat hours and GO Safari Balls for everyone; the optional $11.99 ticket adds Special Research, a Shiny boost and 6 Special Trades a day.

timeline.title: Minior Showers: Leonids
timeline.detail: A second Minior core color debuts from Nov 14 at 5pm through Nov 19 at 11:59pm local, with boosted spawns 5-9pm nightly.

timeline.title: Dynamax Trails
timeline.detail: A week-long Dynamax event sits on the calendar after Wild Area; Niantic has not posted details.

timeline.title: November Community Day
timeline.detail: The season page confirms Nov 21 as November's Community Day; the featured Pokemon and bonuses are not announced.

timeline.title: Twilight Wishes
timeline.detail: The season's closing event starts on the window's last day and runs to Nov 30 at 8pm local; details are not posted.

weekly_rhythm: Spotlight Hour is Thursdays 6-7pm local; Raid Hour is Wednesdays 6-7pm local; Max Monday Max Battles run 6am-9pm local; Daily Discoveries pause Nov 9-15
Spotlight Hours: Morelull Oct 22 (2x catch Stardust); Gastly Oct 29 (2x evolve XP); witch-hat Teddiursa Nov 5 (2x evolve XP); Nov 12 and Nov 19 not posted
Max Mondays: Sableye Oct 26; Machop Nov 2; Into the Wild Max Battles Nov 11 Registeel, Nov 12 Regidrago, Nov 13 Latias and Latios (each with a 6-7pm hour); Nov 16 TBA; Espurr Nov 23

5-star raids: Palkia Oct 21-27; Giratina (Origin) Oct 28 - Nov 3; Giratina (Altered) Nov 4-8; Crowned Zacian and Zamazenta Nov 9-13; Wild Area Global brings Zekrom and White Kyurem Nov 14, Reshiram and Black Kyurem Nov 15; Cresselia and Darkrai Nov 16-24
Raid Hours: Palkia Oct 21; Giratina (Origin) Oct 28; Giratina (Altered) Nov 4; Zacian Mon Nov 9 and Zamazenta Tue Nov 10; Cresselia and Darkrai Nov 18

Mega Raids: Charizard X and Y Oct 21-27; Sableye Oct 28 - Nov 8; none listed Nov 9-15; Banette Nov 16-24; Shadow Landorus in weekend Shadow Raids through Nov 3, Shadow Tornadus Nov 4-8 and Nov 16 - Dec 1

GO Battle League (rotates Tuesdays 1pm PT): Ultra, Master Mega and Fantasy Cup Oct 20-27; Master and Mega Halloween Cup Oct 27 - Nov 3; Mega Editions of all three leagues Nov 3-10; Great, Ultra Mega and 2026 GO LAIC Cup Nov 10-17; Ultra, Master Mega and LAIC Cup Nov 17-24; Master and Mega Catch Cup Nov 24 - Dec 1
GO Pass: November is not announced; October's pass ends Nov 3 at 10am local, so expect the next one then (estimate); Mega Chandelure's Global Challenge bonuses run Nov 2-15

In-person and regional: Pokemon Night Out at Intuit Dome (LA) Oct 24 and The O2 (London) Nov 10 for attendees; Wild Area 2026 in Sendai and Mexico City Nov 6-8 (no US stop); Festival of Lights Nov 6-8 is India only
just_past_window: Nov 25 - Dec 1: Deoxys (all four formes) in 5-star raids with Raid Hour Nov 25, Mega Metagross in Mega Raids; Noibat Spotlight Hour Nov 26 (2x catch Candy)
Nov 28: Super Mega Raid Day, 2-5pm local (featured Mega not announced); Nov 30: Twilight Wishes ends and Cryogonal Max Monday
Dec 1: Twilight Trails ends at 10am local after the Master League and Mega Catch Cup week; the next season is not announced

games.typical_lead_time: The Pokemon Company announces Pokopia events about 2-3 weeks ahead on pokemon.com

timeline.title: Pumpkaboo's Sweet Surprises
timeline.detail: Learn Camouflage from Zorua, prank Pokemon for pumpkin candy and trade it at the Pokemon Center for nine spooky furniture pieces and the Trick or Treat frame before Nov 1 at 4:59am local; Pumpkaboo and Gourgeist stay afterward.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Ditto Rug
timeline.detail: Claim the launch Ditto Rug via Mystery Gift over the internet before Jan 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass: Part 1 out now, Part 2 late 2026
timeline.detail: The pass includes Bubbly Basin now, accessories and new Pokemon in Part 2 late this year (no new town), and a third town in 2027; buying by Aug 31, 2027 emails a code for 30 rare Pokemetal ingots, valid through Sep 30, 2027.

weekly_rhythm: Version 2.0.0 (Aug 5) is still the current build: Dive, Bubbly Basin, the portal pod and bulk storage moves; no newer patch has shipped or been announced
No November event is announced yet; Pumpkaboo was announced Sep 30 for Oct 17, so a late-November event would normally surface in early November
No Mystery Gift codes are active for US players; the Berry Furniture Set code from Oct 29 is for Japan and Korea retail bundles only
just_past_window: Expansion Pass Part 2 is still only dated "late 2026": accessories, new furniture and Pokemon, no new town

games.typical_lead_time: Pawprint posts update notices on aniimo.com about 2 days before maintenance

timeline.title: Windchaser's Departure: Irisalis
timeline.detail: Collect weekly Iris Petals to craft the Legendary Aniipod for Irisalis, then the Blessing Gifts pod for a guaranteed Perfect-potential Sparkling capture, before Dec 9 at 7:59pm on the Americas server.

timeline.title: Journey Chronicles login event
timeline.detail: Log in on enough days to claim every travel gift, including the day-7 Sparkling Egg, before the event closes Oct 29 at 3:59am Americas server time.

timeline.title: Vein Abundance: Prismana Carnival
timeline.detail: Prismana Glynsera, Melloblum, Waleetle and Inferlupa all spawn at once in Beast Fang Ridge, Rosetower Woods, Berylline Vale and Nimbus Fields to close out Part I.
timeline.estimate_basis: In-game calendar via AniimoTools; the official notice only lists weeks through Oct 12

timeline.title: Season 1 Part II: Whisperwake Isles
timeline.detail: After the Oct 29 update, reach Lv. 55 and Trailblazer I to open the Whisperwake Isles (32 new species, 51 Aniimo), with Prismana Hypnyto and Ekrim from the Companion Handbook and Season Achievements, permanent 1v1 duels, and Tidal Path login rewards through Dec 9; maintenance time is not posted yet.

timeline.title: Night Parade and Magical Night (Halloween)
timeline.detail: Decorate the Candy House and mix fragrances in Night Parade for an Aniipod Ultra, Tumbler and Avatar Frame, and grow Magic Pumpkins and Memoryglow Fruit for the Pumpkin God in the Magical Night home event.

timeline.title: Hoptail limited discovery
timeline.detail: Season-exclusive Hoptail is only obtainable through Aniimo Discovery for two weeks per the Part II preview.

timeline.title: Prismana Snapshots
timeline.detail: Photograph Prismana Aniimo for rewards during the Part II snapshot event.

timeline.title: Jaguaraun: Resonance Fantasia
timeline.detail: The first Pathfinder-designed Aniimo (Co-Dev Contest winner) arrives through the Resonance Fantasia event; the second Co-Dev Contest is announced as coming soon.

timeline.title: Carry over your beta rewards
timeline.detail: Log in with the email you used for the beta tests, or link it in Account Center before creating a character, or the test rewards cannot be claimed.

weekly_rhythm: Holo-Battle Interlink runs weekly from Thursday 04:00 to Monday 03:59 server time, with Star Rank and Support rewards resetting each cycle; Hatch Haste halves egg timers every Friday to Sunday (tracker)

Now: Companion Handbook EXP boost below level 70 since Oct 19; Home Season Stage 3 "Harvest Gathering" opens Oct 20 at 4:00 p.m. Americas server time; Batlock Holmes outfit in the Shop since Oct 16 (380 Lumin Crystals per AniimoTools); Radiant Waveglow (980) and Laurel Moon Blessing (280) remain

Part II Vein Abundance (official preview, dates only): Oct 30 - Nov 1 Crescent Bay; Nov 2-8 Prismana Pouchwisp; Nov 9-15 Prismana Royalby; Nov 16-22 Prismana Jeburst; Nov 23-29 Prismana Glameep; Nov 30 - Dec 6 Prismana Carnival

Tracker calendar (unofficial): Part I ends Oct 28 at 11:59pm UTC and unspent Windborn Stamps convert to Credits; Glamour Star Oct 23-29 (Sleepless Night), Nov 6-12 and Nov 20-26; Who's That Aniimo? Oct 16-22 and Oct 30 - Nov 5; Tiered Grand Gifts Oct 18-28
Still unposted: the Oct 29 maintenance window, version number and compensation; Version 1.1 (fixed Irisalis Innate Potential, Legendary Aniipods on Sparkling Aniimo) has no date
just_past_window: Nov 29: Prismana Snapshots and the Glameep week end; Nov 30 - Dec 6: Part II Prismana Carnival in the Whisperwake Isles
Dec 4-10: Glamour Star round, per the in-game calendar
Dec 9: Part II, Irisalis, Night Parade and Tidal Path all close; the next update is dated Dec 10 in the preview
